observations: The photos show a Nikon AF-S Nikkor 50mm f/1.8G lens.
The lens is resting on bubble wrap.
A second, identical lens is visible in the background of all three photos.
The front element appears clean in the provided angles, but internal and rear views are missing.
The text 'AF-S NIKKOR 50mm 1.8G' is clearly legible on the front ring.
The brand 'Nikon' is visible on the lens barrel and front ring.
There is a watermark 'OLAJIDE AMOS BISHOP' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' on the images.
The seller's description includes specifications for a camera body (shutter count, battery, charger) which do not apply to a lens.

claims.evidence: Photos show a clean exterior but do not confirm internal or mechanical condition.
Lenses do not have shutter counts; this is a camera body specification.

claims.claim: no fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: The front element looks clear, but the rear element and internal glass are not shown.
Lenses do not use batteries or chargers.

risks.proof: A video showing the lens successfully autofocusing on a compatible camera body.

risks.risk: Scratches or coating damage on the rear element
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the rear glass element.

risks.risk: Internal fungus, haze, or excessive dust
risks.proof: A photo taken through the lens while it is pointed at a bright light source.
risks.if_unproven: as having optical defects requiring professional cleaning

risks.proof: A video showing the aperture blades opening and closing quickly when the manual lever is flicked.

proof_requests: Photo of the rear glass element.
Photo looking through the lens against a bright light to check for fungus/haze.
Video of the lens autofocusing on a camera.
Video of the aperture blades being manually operated.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Nikon 50mm f/1.8G lens. Although the seller's text is copied from a camera body advertisement, the lens itself can be priced at its worst-case functional condition.
